headword: {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}
gloss: freedom of the press; press freedom

definitions.gloss: freedom of the press; the right of the media to report news without government restriction
definitions.explanation: The principle that the news media should be free to gather and publish information without censorship or interference from the government. A foundational concept in democratic societies, protected in Japan under Article 21 of the Constitution.

examples.japanese: {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}は{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}の{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: Freedom of the press is fundamental to democracy.

examples.japanese: その{国|くに}では{報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}が{制限|せいげん}されている。
examples.english: In that country, press freedom is restricted.

examples.japanese: {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}とプライバシーの{保護|ほご}のバランスをどう{取|と}るかが{議論|ぎろん}されている。
examples.english: There is debate about how to balance press freedom with the protection of privacy.

notes:
Composed of {報道|ほうどう} (news reporting) + の (possessive) + {自由|じゆう} (freedom). A set political and legal phrase.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}を{守|まも}る: to protect press freedom
- {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}が{脅|おびや}かされる: press freedom is threatened
- {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}ランキング: press freedom ranking
- {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}の{侵害|しんがい}: violation of press freedom

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう} ranking by Reporters Without Borders ({国境|こっきょう}なき{記者|きしゃ}{団|だん}) has been a topic of public debate, as Japan's ranking has fluctuated significantly. Issues cited include the press club ({記者|きしゃ}クラブ) system, government pressure on media, and self-censorship.

- {言論|げんろん}の{自由|じゆう}: freedom of speech
- {信教|しんきょう}の{自由|じゆう}: freedom of religion
- {学問|がくもん}の{自由|じゆう}: academic freedom
